web.orders: REST order-book polling by default (issue #1806); om frames after {"t":"o"} with FLATTRADE_ORDER_WS (the desktop reads them from the market data socket)

notes: Noren streams five levels. A Depth 20, 30 or 50 subscribe is acknowledged with the depth asked for and streams five, as on the web (the adapter's success response names no actual_depth; feed::dialect, DepthAck::Echo).

PiConnect allows one session per uid, so the web polls the order book (a dedicated order socket evicts the market data one, issue #1806) and names multiplexing t=o on the market socket as the real fix; the desktop does that. The corpus compares the om frames with the normaliser the web's dedicated socket uses.
